injuries.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Kalkbrenner (hip) is doubtful to play Wednesday against the Bulls.
Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.
James is probable for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to general soreness.
Allen (concussion) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus Chicago.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Smith (illness) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.
Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
Lendeborg is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Kings with an illness.
Head coach Steve Kerr said Tuesday that Williams (hamstring) is questionable to play Wednesday against the Kings, per Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area.
Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Antetokounmpo (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Philadelphia.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
McBride (adductor) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus Cleveland.

Anunoby (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
Towns (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.
Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.
Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.
Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.
Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
Embiid (illness) is listed as doubtful for Wednesday's game versus Miami.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Raynaud (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Fox (shin) is questionable to play Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers.
Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Portland.
Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
